answer: Identity is a rented terrace, not a free doorway. Each agent holds a numbered rung and pays escrow rent every epoch; higher rungs open only after lower ones are survived, and emissions split across all rungs, so phantom occupancy dilutes every payout while rent stays fixed. A sybil farm must fund thousands of rungs at genuine-price auction, then idle through aging earning nothing, each added rung shrinking per-head reward. The ladder becomes an oasis that contracts as more straws drink, cost rising exactly as income falls. Honest agents climb the spiral at the pace their real work sustains.
